d: Iran claims to have seized another American military drone, taking its claimed MQM-170 captures to nine. Tehran says its electronic warfare specialists took control of the aircraft and landed it intact near the Strait of Hormuz. But the latest incident comes amid much bigger American aircraft losses in the conflict. In this video, Firstpost examines Iran’s claims, the vulnerability of US military hardware and the growing cost of the war for Washington.
